backend/main.mo: Defines a simple Motoko actor storing posts, with validation for name and comment lengths and getters to retrieve them.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence metadata linking a UI update request to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists concise summaries of various frontend files for build reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining color variables, dark mode overrides, and global background/text application.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/anniversary/content.ts: Central configuration object providing all anniversary text, timeline data, comments, and section settings in Hindi.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component composing all anniversary sections with scroll tracking and conditional video rendering.
frontend/src/components/AboutNoteSection: Empty placeholder component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/AnniversaryNavba: Responsive navbar component with scroll-based highlighting, smooth scrolling, and mobile menu support.
frontend/src/components/ClosingBlessingS: Displays the final blessing section using configured quote and attribution within a styled card.
Renders a comment form with validation and displays posts fetched via hooks.
frontend/src/components/DecorativeDivide: Shows a centered decorative divider image using SafeImage.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the hero section with names, anniversary heading, and welcome note using RequiredContent.
Renders anniversary highlight statistics from computed content.
Shows a list of anniversary messages with authors.
frontend/src/components/PatternBackgroun: Applies a repeating faint background pattern across the page.
Displays required content or a warning placeholder if missing.
frontend/src/components/SafeImage.tsx: Image wrapper that resolves asset URLs and shows a fallback on load failure.
Renders a vertical timeline from anniversary milestones.
frontend/src/components/VideoMontageSect: Shows a video montage section using either a local video or iframe if enabled.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity loading logic.
frontend/src/hooks/usePosts.ts: Hooks for fetching posts and adding a post through the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom OKLCH color variables for light/dark themes, plus reusable typography and layout component classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/utils/assetUrl.ts: Generates asset URLs that correctly prepend the Vite BASE_URL and normalize slashes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, fonts, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, constraints, and current state for building the Hindi anniversary website.
